items.label: CleanSpark 10-K (11-25-2025)
items.signal_prefix: CleanSpark's 10-K: its one mining pool operator

set.signal: CleanSpark's 10-K: its one mining pool operator, Foundry Digital, represented 100% of the company's total revenues in fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, as all bitcoin mining rewards are received through Foundry Digital's open access mining pool; rewards are distributed proportionally to CleanSpark's contribution to the pool's mining power, and the pool has sole discretion to modify the terms of the agreement at any time. Bitcoin mining revenues are recorded net of the pool fees charged by Foundry, approximately 0.17% of gross bitcoin mining revenues in fiscal 2025 (0.16% in fiscal 2024). All of its bitcoin reside with one custodian.

items.label: Riot Platforms 10-K (03-02-2026)

set.signal: 10-K: Riot states its business model is shifting toward data center development alongside bitcoin mining, and that it manages exposure to bitcoin price volatility by investing in energy-efficient miners and vertical integration and by diversifying its revenue through data center initiatives. Under its Bitcoin Treasury Strategy it selectively sells bitcoin to fund operational needs, capital expenditures and strategic initiatives: it sold 5,363 bitcoin for proceeds of $535,486 thousand in 2025 and held 18,005 bitcoin at December 31, 2025.
